ev.q: As of June 10, a total of 53 cases had been investigated in Illinois, Indiana, and Wisconsin.
For the majority of patients (22 [73%]), a febrile illness has either preceded or accompanied the onset of a papular rash
Of these, 29 (49%) cases were among males; the median age was 26 years
A total of 14 (26%) patients have been hospitalized
This report summarizes initial descriptive epidemiologic, clinical, and laboratory data
Detailed clinical information was available for 30 cases reported in Illinois and Wisconsin.
